class SettingsModificationUsecase:
    def __init__(
        self,
        db_repository: RobotCollectionRepository,
        llm_models: Dict = None,
        cache_repository: CacheRepositoryInterface = None,
    ):
        self.llm_models = llm_models
        self.db_repository = db_repository
        self.cache_repository = cache_repository
        self.chain_detection = ChainDetection.template | self.llm_models["o3-mini"] | ChainDetection.parser
        self.chain_detection_autorag = (
            RAGChainDetection.template | self.llm_models["o3-mini"] | RAGChainDetection.parser
        )

    def get_pipeline_type(self, collection_info) -> str:
        if self.db_repository.__class__.__name__ == "EcommerceElasticsearchRepository" or (
            isinstance(collection_info.woocommerce_auth, dict)
            and isinstance(collection_info.woocommerce_auth.get("store_url", None), str)
        ):
            return "AutoLangGraph"
        else:
            return "AutoRag"

    def escape_single_braces(self, text: str) -> str:
        text = re.sub(r"(?<!{){(?!{)", "{{", text)
        text = re.sub(r"(?<!})}(?!})", "}}", text)
        return text

    def partial_format(self, template: PromptTemplate, additional_instructions: List[str]) -> str:
        instructions_string = "\n".join([f"- {ins}" for ins in additional_instructions])
        instructions_string += "\n{additional_instructions}"

        variables = template.partial_variables
        variables["additional_instructions"] = instructions_string
        for iv in template.input_variables:
            variables[iv] = f"{{{iv}}}"

        if "format_instructions" in variables:
            variables["format_instructions"] = self.escape_single_braces(variables["format_instructions"])

        return template.template.format(**variables)

    def partial_node_format(self, template: PromptTemplate, additional_instructions: List[str]) -> str:
        instructions_string = "\n".join([f"- {ins}" for ins in additional_instructions])

        variables = template.partial_variables
        variables["additional_instructions"] = instructions_string

        for iv in template.input_variables:
            variables[iv] = f"{{{iv}}}"

        if "format_instructions" in variables:
            variables["format_instructions"] = self.escape_single_braces(variables["format_instructions"])

        return template.template.format(**variables)

    async def update_prompts(self, new_prompts: Dict, pipline_type: str = "AutoLangGraph") -> Dict:
        result = await run_chain(
            chain=self.chain_detection if pipline_type == "AutoLangGraph" else self.chain_detection_autorag,
            parameters={"user_prompt": new_prompts["basic_prompt"]},
            max_retries=5,
            name="user_prompt_formatter",
            assertion=(
                "assert isinstance(result['Instructions'], list)"
                if pipline_type == "AutoLangGraph"
                else "assert 'chains' in result"
            ),
            ensure_value_quates=False,
            double_quates2single_quate=False,
        )

        self.set_result_in_collection_setting(new_prompts, result, pipline_type)
        return new_prompts

    def set_result_in_collection_setting(self, new_prompts, result, pipline_type):
        prompt_name_mapper, prompt_name_mapper_autorag, _ = PromptMapperFactory.create()
        if pipline_type == "AutoLangGraph":
            for tool in result["Instructions"]:
                if tool["name"] in prompt_name_mapper:
                    prompt_class = prompt_name_mapper[tool["name"]]["object"]
                    if "first_generations" in tool["name"]:
                        for attr in dir(prompt_class):
                            if attr.endswith("_message_template"):
                                template = getattr(prompt_class, attr)
                                prompt_name = attr.removesuffix("template") + "prompt"
                                new_prompts[prompt_name] = self.partial_format(template, tool["Instructions"])
                    elif tool["name"] in ["Assistant", "SearchProductsByNameRepoTool"]:
                        promtp_saving_name = prompt_name_mapper[tool["name"]]["saving_name"]
                        new_prompts[promtp_saving_name] = self.partial_node_format(prompt_class, tool["Instructions"])

                    elif tool["name"] in ["GetOrderTool"]:
                        for prompt in prompt_class:
                            prompt_saving_name = next(iter(prompt))
                            prompt_value = prompt[prompt_saving_name]
                            new_prompts[prompt_saving_name] = self.partial_node_format(
                                prompt_value, tool["Instructions"]
                            )

                    elif tool["name"] in [
                        "fact_verification",
                        "exact_verification_1",
                        "exact_verification_2",
                        "verify_question",
                        "final_response",
                        "final_mismatch_response",
                    ]:
                        pass

                    else:
                        promtp_saving_name = prompt_name_mapper[tool["name"]]["saving_name"]
                        new_prompts[promtp_saving_name] = self.partial_format(
                            prompt_class.template, tool["Instructions"]
                        )
        else:
            for chain in result["chains"]:
                if chain["chain_name"] in prompt_name_mapper_autorag:
                    prompt_class = prompt_name_mapper_autorag[chain["chain_name"]]["object"]
                    if chain["chain_name"] == "first_generations":
                        for attr in dir(prompt_class):
                            if attr.endswith("_message_template"):
                                template = getattr(prompt_class, attr)
                                prompt_name = attr.removesuffix("template") + "prompt"
                                new_prompts[prompt_name] = self.partial_format(template, chain["instructions"])
                    elif chain["chain_name"] in [
                        "fact_verification",
                        "exact_verification_1",
                        "exact_verification_2",
                        "verify_question",
                        "final_response",
                        "final_mismatch_response",
                    ]:
                        pass
                    else:
                        promtp_saving_name = prompt_name_mapper_autorag[chain["chain_name"]]["saving_name"]
                        new_prompts[promtp_saving_name] = self.partial_format(
                            prompt_class.template, chain["instructions"]
                        )

    def _process_prompts_with_removal(self, collection_info: CollectionInfo, new_prompts: Dict) -> None:
        """Process prompts and handle removal markers.

        Args:
            collection_info: Collection information to update.
            new_prompts: Dictionary of new prompts to process.
        """
        collection_info.prompts = new_prompts

        prompts_to_remove = []
        for key, value in collection_info.prompts.items():
            if value == "<REMOVE>":
                prompts_to_remove.append(key)

        for prompt in prompts_to_remove:
            del collection_info.prompts[prompt]

    def _is_basic_prompt_empty(self, basic_prompt: str) -> bool:
        """Check if basic prompt is effectively empty.

        Args:
            basic_prompt: The basic prompt string to check.

        Returns:
            True if prompt is empty or too short, False otherwise.
        """
        return len(basic_prompt.strip()) <= 5

    def _has_basic_prompt_changed(self, new_basic_prompt: str, collection_info: CollectionInfo) -> bool:
        """Check if basic prompt has changed from current collection prompts.

        Args:
            new_basic_prompt: The new basic prompt to compare.
            collection_info: Current collection information.

        Returns:
            True if prompt has changed, False otherwise.
        """
        current_basic_prompt = (collection_info.prompts or {}).get("basic_prompt", "")
        return new_basic_prompt != current_basic_prompt

    async def _handle_basic_prompt_update(self, new_prompts: Dict, collection_info: CollectionInfo) -> None:
        """Handle basic prompt validation and update.

        Args:
            new_prompts: Dictionary containing new prompts.
            collection_info: Collection information to update.
        """
        basic_prompt = new_prompts.get("basic_prompt", "")

        if self._is_basic_prompt_empty(basic_prompt):
            collection_info.prompts = {}
            return

        if self._has_basic_prompt_changed(basic_prompt, collection_info):
            pipeline_type = self.get_pipeline_type(collection_info)
            await self.update_prompts(new_prompts=new_prompts, pipline_type=pipeline_type)

    async def _process_prompts_conditionally(self, new_settings: Dict, collection_info: CollectionInfo) -> None:
        """Process prompts based on conditions and update collection info.

        Args:
            new_settings: Dictionary containing new settings.
            collection_info: Collection information to update.
        """
        prompts = new_settings.get("prompts")
        if not prompts:
            return

        has_initial_prompt = "initial_prompt" in prompts
        if has_initial_prompt:
            return

        has_basic_prompt = "basic_prompt" in prompts
        if has_basic_prompt:
            await self._handle_basic_prompt_update(prompts, collection_info)

        self._process_prompts_with_removal(collection_info, prompts)

    @tracer(trace_type="settings_modification", identifier_path="collection_info.identifier")
    async def modify_settings(
        self,
        collection_info: CollectionInfo,
        collection_setting: CollectionSetting,
    ) -> None:
        new_settings = collection_setting.model_dump(exclude_none=True)

        await self._process_prompts_conditionally(new_settings, collection_info)

        for key, value in new_settings.items():
            if key == "prompts":
                continue
            if key == "manual_title" and len(value.strip()) <= 5:
                value = None
            if key == "default_assigning_operator_message" and len(value.strip()) <= 5:
                value = InferenceMessages.operator_message
            if key == "dynamic_language":
                default_lang = value.get("default_language", "AUTO")
                if default_lang == "AUTO":
                    collection_info.dynamic_language["use_dynamic_language"] = True
                    collection_info.dynamic_language["default_language"] = "PERSIAN"
                else:
                    collection_info.dynamic_language["use_dynamic_language"] = False
                    collection_info.dynamic_language["default_language"] = default_lang
                continue
            collection_info.__setattr__(key, value)

        collection_info.updated_at = datetime.now().strftime(
            "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ",
        )

        await self.db_repository.add_collection_info_to_collection(
            collection_info.identifier, collection_info, version_up=True
        )

    @tracer(trace_type="prompt_modification", identifier_path="collection_info.identifier")
    async def update_structured_prompt(
        self, input_data: PromptModificationInput, ai_pipeline=None, data_indexing_pipeline=None, collection_info=None
    ):
        """Execute the two-stage prompt modification pipeline.

        Args:
            input_data: Input containing collection ID and user-modified prompt.
            collection_info: Optional collection info (if already fetched).

        Returns:
            PromptModificationResponse with acceptable prompt, non-acceptable parts, and collection prompts.

        Raises:
            DomainValidationError: If business rules are violated.
        """
        if not input_data.user_modified_prompt or len(input_data.user_modified_prompt.strip()) <= 13:
            cache_key = make_cache_key(
                CacheKeyPattern.PROMPT,
                owner_id=str(collection_info.user_id),
                collection_identifier=collection_info.identifier,
                version="validation",
            )
            cache_data = {
                "acceptable_prompt": "",
                "rejected_parts": [],
                "user_modified_prompt": "",
                "modified_module_prompt": {"initial_prompt": ""},
                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            }
            cache_status = await self.cache_repository.set(cache_key, cache_data, ttl_secs=300)
            return PromptModificationResponse(
                success=cache_status is None,
                cost=0,
                acceptable_prompt="",
                rejected_parts=[],
                related_information={},
            )

        if collection_info is None:
            collection_info = await self.db_repository.get_collection_info_by_id(input_data.collection_identifier)

        self._current_collection_info = collection_info

        # original_template = self._get_original_template_from_collection(collection_info)
        original_template = DefaultPrompt.support_prompt

        diff_analysis = await self._analyze_prompt_structure(original_template, input_data.user_modified_prompt)
        sections_data = diff_analysis.get("structured_prompt", diff_analysis)
        sections_result = await self._format_sections_parallel(sections_data, ai_pipeline, data_indexing_pipeline)

        acceptable_prompt, rejected_parts, modified_modules = self._validate_and_categorize_sections(
            sections_result, diff_analysis
        )

        cache_key = make_cache_key(
            CacheKeyPattern.PROMPT,
            owner_id=str(collection_info.user_id),
            collection_identifier=collection_info.identifier,
            version="validation",
        )
        cache_data = {
            "acceptable_prompt": acceptable_prompt,
            "rejected_parts": rejected_parts,
            "user_modified_prompt": input_data.user_modified_prompt,
            "modified_module_prompt": modified_modules,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        }
        cache_status = await self.cache_repository.set(cache_key, cache_data, ttl_secs=300)

        return PromptModificationResponse(
            success=cache_status is None,
            cost=3,
            acceptable_prompt=acceptable_prompt,
            rejected_parts=rejected_parts,
            related_information={},
        )

    def _get_original_template_from_collection(self, collection_info) -> str:
        """Retrieve original template content from collection info.

        Args:
            collection_info: Collection information containing prompts.

        Returns:
            Original template content or default template.
        """
        if hasattr(collection_info, "prompts") and collection_info.prompts:
            # Try to get basic_prompt as the main template
            if "basic_prompt" in collection_info.prompts:
                return collection_info.prompts["basic_prompt"]

            # If no basic_prompt, try to get any available prompt as template
            for _, value in collection_info.prompts.items():
                if value and len(str(value).strip()) > 50:  # Reasonable length check
                    return str(value)

        # Default template if nothing found
        return DefaultPrompt.support_prompt

    async def _analyze_prompt_structure(self, original_template: str, user_edited_prompt: str) -> Dict:
        """Stage A: Analyze structure differences between templates."""
        structure_formatter = StructurePromptFormatter()
        chain = structure_formatter.template | self.llm_models["light-model"] | structure_formatter.parser

        user_edited_prompt = user_edited_prompt.replace("{", "[").replace("}", "]")

        parameters = {"original_template": original_template, "user_edited_prompt": user_edited_prompt}

        result = await run_chain(
            chain=chain,
            parameters=parameters,
            max_retries=3,
            name="structure_prompt_formatter",
            assertion="isinstance(result, dict)",
        )

        return result

    async def _format_sections_parallel(
        self, diff_analysis: Dict, ai_pipeline: Any, data_indexing_pipeline: Any
    ) -> Dict:
        """Stage B: Format all sections in parallel and return section modifications info.

        Returns:
            Dict containing:
            - section_contents: Dict of section_name -> content
            - module_modifications: List of dicts with module_name, placeholder, content
            - validation_errors: List of validation errors
        """
        section_formatters = {
            "chatbot_introduction": BotIntroductionSectionFormatter(),
            "organization_information": CollectionIntroductionSectionFormatter(),
            "response_guidelines": ResponseGuidelinesSectionFormatter(),
            "operator_escalation_processes": ReferralProcessSectionFormatter(),
        }

        tasks = []
        section_keys = []
        section_contents = {}
        module_modifications = []
        validation_errors = []

        for section_key, formatter in section_formatters.items():
            if section_key in diff_analysis and diff_analysis[section_key].get("state") == "modified":
                if section_key == "chatbot_introduction":
                    task = self._process_chatbot_introduction_section(section_key, diff_analysis[section_key])
                elif section_key == "response_guidelines":
                    task = self._process_response_guidelines_section(section_key, diff_analysis[section_key])
                elif section_key == "organization_information":
                    task = self._process_organization_information_section(
                        section_key, formatter, diff_analysis[section_key], ai_pipeline, data_indexing_pipeline
                    )
                else:
                    task = self._format_single_section(section_key, formatter, diff_analysis[section_key])

                tasks.append(task)
                section_keys.append(section_key)

            elif section_key in diff_analysis and diff_analysis[section_key].get("state") == "unchanged":
                section_contents[section_key] = getattr(DefaultPrompt, section_key)

        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

        for _, result in enumerate(results):
            section_key = result.section_name

            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                validation_errors.append(f"Error processing {section_key}: {str(result)}")
                continue

            section_contents[section_key] = result.content
            validation_errors.extend(result.validation_rules.get("rejected_parst", []))
            module_modifications.extend(result.validation_rules.get("module_modifications", []))

        return {
            "section_contents": section_contents,
            "module_modifications": module_modifications,
            "validation_errors": validation_errors,
        }

    async def _format_single_section(
        self, section_name: str, formatter: BasePrompt, section_diff: Dict
    ) -> StructuredPromptSection:
        """Format a single section using its specific formatter."""
        chain = formatter.template | self.llm_models["light-model"] | formatter.parser

        parameters = {
            "original_template": DefaultPrompt.operator_escalation_processes,
            "user_edited_prompt": section_diff.get("text", ""),
        }

        result = await run_chain(
            chain=chain,
            parameters=parameters,
            max_retries=3,
            name=f"{section_name}_section_formatter",
            assertion="len(result) > 10",
        )

        _, AutoRag_prompt_mapper, _ = PromptMapperFactory.create()
        prompt_object, saving_name = AutoRag_prompt_mapper.get("query_tag").values()
        original_template = prompt_object.template.template
        module_modifications = self.get_module_modifications(original_template, result, saving_name)

        return StructuredPromptSection(
            section_name=section_name,  # .replace("_", " "),
            content=result["formatted_section"].get("final_prompt", ""),
            validation_rules={
                "rejected_parst": result["formatted_section"].get("rejected_changes", ""),
                "changed_parts": result["formatted_section"].get("changed_prompts", ""),
                "module_modifications": module_modifications,
            },
        )

    def get_module_modifications(self, original_template, result, saving_name):
        module_modifications = []
        if "{additional_instructions}" in original_template:
            changed_prompts = result["formatted_section"].get("changed_prompts", "")
            if changed_prompts not in ["", []]:
                module_modifications.append(
                    {
                        "module_name": saving_name,
                        "placeholder": "{additional_instructions}",
                        "content": str(changed_prompts),
                    }
                )
        return module_modifications

    def _validate_sections(self, sections: List[StructuredPromptSection]) -> None:
        """Validate all sections against business rules."""
        for section in sections:
            if not section.content or len(section.content.strip()) < 10:
                raise DomainValidationError(f"Section {section.section_name} content is too short or empty")

            # Additional validation based on section type
            if "چت بات" in section.section_name and "نام" not in section.content:
                raise DomainValidationError("Bot name is required in bot introduction section")

    def _validate_and_categorize_sections(
        self, sections_result: Dict, diff_analysis: Dict
    ) -> tuple[str, List[str], Dict]:
        """Validate sections and categorize into acceptable prompt and non-acceptable parts.

        Args:
            sections_result: Result from _format_sections_parallel containing section_contents,
                           module_modifications, and validation_errors.
            diff_analysis: Analysis results containing structured prompt information.

        Returns:
            Tuple of (acceptable_prompt, non_acceptable_parts, modified_modules_dict).
        """
        section_contents = sections_result.get("section_contents", {})
        module_modifications = sections_result.get("module_modifications", [])
        validation_errors = sections_result.get("validation_errors", [])

        acceptable_prompt_parts = self._build_acceptable_prompt_parts(section_contents, diff_analysis)
        acceptable_prompt = self._join_prompt_parts(acceptable_prompt_parts)
        modified_modules = self._apply_module_modifications(module_modifications)

        self._add_basic_prompt_if_needed(acceptable_prompt, modified_modules)

        return acceptable_prompt, validation_errors, modified_modules

    def _build_acceptable_prompt_parts(self, section_contents: Dict, diff_analysis: Dict) -> List[str]:
        """Build list of acceptable prompt parts from section contents and unchanged sections.

        Args:
            section_contents: Dictionary of section contents.
            diff_analysis: Analysis results containing structured prompt information.

        Returns:
            List of formatted prompt parts.
        """
        acceptable_prompt_parts = []

        processed_sections = self._process_ordered_sections(section_contents)
        acceptable_prompt_parts.extend(processed_sections)

        unchanged_sections = self._process_unchanged_sections(diff_analysis, section_contents)
        acceptable_prompt_parts.extend(unchanged_sections)

        return acceptable_prompt_parts

    def _process_ordered_sections(self, section_contents: Dict) -> List[str]:
        """Process sections in predefined order.

        Args:
            section_contents: Dictionary of section contents.

        Returns:
            List of formatted section parts.
        """
        section_order = [
            ("chatbot_introduction", "## معرفی چت‌بات"),
            ("organization_information", "## معرفی مجموعه/موسسه/شرکت"),
            ("response_guidelines", "## اصول پاسخ‌گویی"),
            ("operator_escalation_processes", "## فرایندهای ارجاع"),
        ]

        processed_sections = []

        for section_key, section_header in section_order:
            if self._is_valid_section_content(section_contents, section_key):
                content = section_contents[section_key]
                processed_sections.append(f"{section_header}\n{content}")

        return processed_sections

    def _process_unchanged_sections(self, diff_analysis: Dict, section_contents: Dict) -> List[str]:
        """Process unchanged sections from diff analysis.

        Args:
            diff_analysis: Analysis results containing structured prompt information.
            section_contents: Dictionary of section contents to check for duplicates.

        Returns:
            List of formatted unchanged section parts.
        """
        unchanged_sections = []

        for section_key, section_data in diff_analysis.get("structured_prompt", {}).items():
            if self._is_unchanged_section_valid(section_data, section_key, section_contents):
                section_header = self._get_section_header(section_key)
                if section_header:
                    unchanged_sections.append(f"{section_header}\n{section_data['text']}")

        return unchanged_sections

    def _is_valid_section_content(self, section_contents: Dict, section_key: str) -> bool:
        """Check if section content is valid.

        Args:
            section_contents: Dictionary of section contents.
            section_key: Key of the section to check.

        Returns:
            True if section content is valid, False otherwise.
        """
        if section_key not in section_contents:
            return False

        content = section_contents[section_key]
        return content and len(content.strip()) > 10

    def _is_unchanged_section_valid(self, section_data: Dict, section_key: str, section_contents: Dict) -> bool:
        """Check if unchanged section is valid for inclusion.

        Args:
            section_data: Data for the unchanged section.
            section_key: Key of the section.
            section_contents: Dictionary of section contents to check for duplicates.

        Returns:
            True if section is valid for inclusion, False otherwise.
        """
        return (
            section_data.get("state") == "unchanged" and section_key not in section_contents and "text" in section_data
        )

    def _join_prompt_parts(self, prompt_parts: List[str]) -> str:
        """Join prompt parts into a single string.

        Args:
            prompt_parts: List of prompt parts to join.

        Returns:
            Joined prompt string.
        """
        return "\n\n".join(prompt_parts) if prompt_parts else ""

    def _add_basic_prompt_if_needed(self, acceptable_prompt: str, modified_modules: Dict) -> None:
        """Add basic prompt to modified modules if needed.

        Args:
            acceptable_prompt: The acceptable prompt string.
            modified_modules: Dictionary of modified modules to update.
        """
        if acceptable_prompt and "basic_prompt" not in modified_modules:
            modified_modules["basic_prompt"] = acceptable_prompt

    def _apply_module_modifications(self, module_modifications: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
        """Apply all module modifications to create the final modified modules dict.

        Args:
            module_modifications: List of modification dicts with module_name, placeholder, content

        Returns:
            Dict of module_name -> final_template after all modifications
        """
        _, autorag_prompt_mapper, generation_prompts = PromptMapperFactory.create()

        modified_modules = self._initialize_base_modules(generation_prompts)
        modifications_by_module = self._group_modifications_by_module(module_modifications)

        self._apply_modifications_to_modules(modified_modules, modifications_by_module, autorag_prompt_mapper)

        return modified_modules

    def _initialize_base_modules(self, generation_prompts: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Initialize base modules from generation prompts.

        Args:
            generation_prompts: Dictionary of generation prompt configurations.

        Returns:
            Dict of initialized base modules.
        """
        modified_modules = {}

        for prompt_name, prompt_info in generation_prompts.items():
            LOGGER.info(f"Processing prompt: {prompt_name}")
            if self._is_valid_prompt_info(prompt_info):
                saving_name = prompt_info["saving_name"]
                prompt_object = prompt_info.get("object")

                template = self._extract_template_from_object(prompt_object)
                if template:
                    modified_modules[saving_name] = template

        return modified_modules

    def _is_valid_prompt_info(self, prompt_info: Any) -> bool:
        """Check if prompt info is valid.

        Args:
            prompt_info: The prompt information to validate.

        Returns:
            True if valid, False otherwise.
        """
        return isinstance(prompt_info, dict) and "saving_name" in prompt_info

    def _extract_template_from_object(self, prompt_object: Any) -> str:
        """Extract template from prompt object.

        Args:
            prompt_object: The prompt object to extract template from.

        Returns:
            Template string if found, None otherwise.
        """
        if prompt_object and hasattr(prompt_object, "template"):
            return prompt_object.template
        elif isinstance(prompt_object, str):
            return prompt_object
        return None

    def _group_modifications_by_module(self, module_modifications: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
        """Group modifications by module name.

        Args:
            module_modifications: List of modification dictionaries.

        Returns:
            Dict mapping module names to their modifications.
        """
        modifications_by_module = {}

        for modification in module_modifications:
            module_name = modification["module_name"]
            if module_name not in modifications_by_module:
                modifications_by_module[module_name] = []
            modifications_by_module[module_name].append(modification)

        return modifications_by_module

    def _apply_modifications_to_modules(
        self, modified_modules: Dict, modifications_by_module: Dict, autorag_prompt_mapper: Dict
    ) -> None:
        """Apply modifications to modules.

        Args:
            modified_modules: Dictionary of modules to modify.
            modifications_by_module: Modifications grouped by module.
            autorag_prompt_mapper: AutoRAG prompt mapper for QueryTag handling.
        """
        for module_name, modifications in modifications_by_module.items():
            if module_name in modified_modules:
                self._apply_modifications_to_existing_module(modified_modules, module_name, modifications)
            elif module_name == "QueryTag":
                self._apply_query_tag_modifications(modified_modules, modifications, autorag_prompt_mapper)
            else:
                self._apply_modifications_to_new_module(modified_modules, module_name, modifications)

    def _apply_modifications_to_existing_module(
        self, modified_modules: Dict, module_name: str, modifications: List[Dict]
    ) -> None:
        """Apply modifications to an existing module.

        Args:
            modified_modules: Dictionary of modules to modify.
            module_name: Name of the module to modify.
            modifications: List of modifications to apply.
        """
        current_template = modified_modules[module_name]

        for modification in modifications:
            placeholder = modification["placeholder"]
            content = modification["content"]

            if placeholder and placeholder in current_template:
                current_template = current_template.replace(placeholder, content)
            elif placeholder is None:
                current_template = content

        modified_modules[module_name] = current_template

    def _apply_query_tag_modifications(
        self, modified_modules: Dict, modifications: List[Dict], autorag_prompt_mapper: Dict
    ) -> None:
        """Apply modifications specifically for QueryTag module.

        Args:
            modified_modules: Dictionary of modules to modify.
            modifications: List of modifications to apply.
            autorag_prompt_mapper: AutoRAG prompt mapper containing QueryTag template.
        """
        query_tag_info = autorag_prompt_mapper.get("query_tag")
        if not query_tag_info:
            LOGGER.warning("QueryTag not found in AutoRAG prompt mapper")
            return

        prompt_object = query_tag_info.get("object")
        saving_name = query_tag_info.get("saving_name", "QueryTag")

        if prompt_object and hasattr(prompt_object, "template"):
            current_template = prompt_object.template.template

            for modification in modifications:
                placeholder = modification["placeholder"]
                content = modification["content"]

                if placeholder and placeholder in current_template:
                    current_template = current_template.replace(placeholder, content)
                elif placeholder is None:
                    current_template = content

            modified_modules[saving_name] = current_template
        else:
            LOGGER.warning(f"QueryTag object does not have expected template structure: {prompt_object}")

    def _apply_modifications_to_new_module(
        self, modified_modules: Dict, module_name: str, modifications: List[Dict]
    ) -> None:
        """Apply modifications to create a new module.

        Args:
            modified_modules: Dictionary of modules to modify.
            module_name: Name of the new module.
            modifications: List of modifications to apply.
        """
        for modification in modifications:
            if modification["module_name"] == module_name:
                modified_modules[module_name] = modification["content"]
                break

    async def _process_chatbot_introduction_section(self, section_name: str, section_diff: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Process chatbot_introduction section and return modification info.

        Args:
            section_name: Name of the section
            section_diff: Section difference data

        Returns:
            Dict with content, module_modifications, and validation_errors
        """
        chatbot_introduction_text = section_diff.get("text", "")

        validation_errors = []
        if not chatbot_introduction_text or len(chatbot_introduction_text.strip()) < 10:
            validation_errors.append("Chatbot introduction content is too short or empty")

        module_modifications = []
        _, _, autorag_generation_prompt = PromptMapperFactory.create()

        for prompt_name, prompt_info in autorag_generation_prompt.items():
            if isinstance(prompt_info, dict) and "saving_name" in prompt_info:
                saving_name = prompt_info["saving_name"]
                prompt_object = prompt_info.get("object")

                if prompt_object and hasattr(prompt_object, "template"):
                    original_template = prompt_object.template
                    if "{basic_prompt}" in original_template:
                        module_modifications.append(
                            {
                                "module_name": saving_name,
                                "placeholder": "{basic_prompt}",
                                "content": chatbot_introduction_text,
                            }
                        )
                elif isinstance(prompt_object, str) and "{basic_prompt}" in prompt_object:
                    module_modifications.append(
                        {
                            "module_name": saving_name,
                            "placeholder": "{basic_prompt}",
                            "content": chatbot_introduction_text,
                        }
                    )

        module_modifications.append(
            {
                "module_name": "basic_prompt",
                "placeholder": None,  # Direct replacement, not placeholder
                "content": chatbot_introduction_text,
            }
        )

        return StructuredPromptSection(
            section_name="chatbot_introduction",
            content=chatbot_introduction_text,
            validation_rules={
                "module_modifications": module_modifications,
                "validation_errors": validation_errors,

    async def _process_organization_information_section(
        self, section_key: str, formatter: BasePrompt, section_diff: Dict, ai_pipeline: Any, data_indexing_pipeline: Any
    ) -> StructuredPromptSection:
        """Process organization_information section and return formatted section.

        Args:
            section_key: Key of the section to process.
            formatter: Formatter instance for the section.
            section_diff: Section difference data.
            ai_pipeline: AI pipeline for processing.

        Returns:
            StructuredPromptSection with formatted content.
        """
        organization_text = section_diff.get("text", "")

        if not organization_text or len(organization_text.strip()) < 10:
            raise DomainValidationError("Organization information content is too short or empty")

        collection_info = getattr(self, "_current_collection_info", None)
        if not collection_info:
            raise PromptModificationError("No collection info available for organization information processing")

        try:
            prompt_summaries_to_delete = await self.db_repository.get_summaries_by_type(
                collection_info.identifier, summary_type="prompt", return_vectors=False
            )

            if prompt_summaries_to_delete:
                for prompt_summary in prompt_summaries_to_delete:
                    await self.db_repository.delete_child_summaries_from_parent_id(
                        collection_info.identifier, prompt_summary.id
                    )

                prompt_summary_ids = [summary.id for summary in prompt_summaries_to_delete]
                await self.db_repository.delete_summaries_from_collection(
                    collection_info.identifier, prompt_summary_ids
                )
                LOGGER.info(
                    f"Deleted {len(prompt_summaries_to_delete)} existing prompt summaries\
                     from collection {collection_info.identifier}"
                )

        except Exception as e:
            LOGGER.warning(f"Error while deleting existing prompt summaries: {e}")

        summary_id = get_current_utc_time()
        organization_summary = Summary(
            id=summary_id,
            type="prompt",
            content=organization_text,
            chunk_ids=[],
        )

        if hasattr(data_indexing_pipeline, "summarizer"):
            summarizer = data_indexing_pipeline.summarizer

            child_summaries = summarizer.create_child_docs([organization_summary])

            await summarizer.vectorize([organization_summary])
            await summarizer.vectorize(child_summaries)

            await self.db_repository.add_summary_data_to_collection(collection_info.identifier, [organization_summary])

            await self.db_repository.add_child_summaries_to_collection(collection_info.identifier, child_summaries)
        else:
            LOGGER.warning(
                "Summarizer not available in data_indexing_pipeline, skipping vectorization and child summary generation"
            )

            await self.db_repository.add_summary_data_to_collection(collection_info.identifier, [organization_summary])

        _, _, AutoRag_prompt_mapper = PromptMapperFactory.create()
        prompt_object, saving_name = AutoRag_prompt_mapper.get("Assistant").values()
        original_template = prompt_object.template
        if "{shop_info}" in original_template:
            module_modifications = []
            module_modifications.append(
                {
                    "module_name": saving_name,
                    "placeholder": "{shop_info}",
                    "content": organization_text,
                }
            )

        return StructuredPromptSection(
            section_name=section_key,  # .replace("_", " "),
            content=organization_text,
            validation_rules={
                "module_modifications": module_modifications,
            },
        )

    async def save_cached_prompt_to_collection(self, collection_identifier: str) -> dict:
        """Retrieve cached prompt validation results and save them to collection in Elasticsearch.

        Args:
            collection_identifier: The identifier of the collection to update.

        Returns:
            Dictionary with save results including updated prompts count and list.

        Raises:
            DomainValidationError: If collection not found or cache empty.
        """
        collection_info = await self.db_repository.get_collection_info_by_id(collection_identifier)

        cache_key = make_cache_key(
            CacheKeyPattern.PROMPT,
            owner_id=str(collection_info.user_id),
            collection_identifier=collection_info.identifier,
            version="validation",
        )
        cached_validation = await self.cache_repository.get(cache_key)

        if not cached_validation:
            raise DomainValidationError(
                f"No cached prompt validation results found for collection {collection_identifier}"
            )

        if not collection_info.prompts:
            collection_info.prompts = {}

        updated_prompts = []

        if cached_validation.get("modified_module_prompt"):
            collection_info.prompts = cached_validation.get("modified_module_prompt")
            collection_info.prompts["initial_prompt"] = cached_validation["acceptable_prompt"]

        collection_info.updated_at = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")

        await self.db_repository.add_collection_info_to_collection(
            collection_info.identifier, collection_info, version_up=True
        )

        return {
            "success": True,
            "saved_prompts_count": len(updated_prompts),
            "updated_prompts": updated_prompts,
            "collection_updated": True,
            "message": f"{len(updated_prompts)} prompt templates saved successfully to collection {collection_identifier}",
            "version_incremented": True,
            "cached_data": {
                "acceptable_prompt": cached_validation.get("acceptable_prompt"),
                "rejected_parts": cached_validation.get("reject_parts", []),
                "timestamp": cached_validation.get("timestamp"),
            },
        }

    def _get_section_header(self, section_key: str) -> str:

"""Abstract command interface for Chain-of-Command pattern.

This module provides the base command abstraction for implementing
chain-of-command pipelines in Clean Architecture use cases.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from abc import ABC
from abc import abstractmethod
from typing import Any
from typing import Dict
from typing import Union

from parschat_logic import LOGGER

class AbstractCommand(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for commands in the Chain-of-Command pattern.
    
    Each command should implement `__call__` to execute its specific logic.
    Commands are stateless and receive dependencies via dependency injection.
    
    Example:
        class DataLoadCommand(AbstractCommand):
            def __init__(self, data_loader: DataLoader):
                self.data_loader = data_loader
            
            async def __call__(self, context: ProcessingContext) -> Any:
                data = await self.data_loader.load(context.datum)
                context.loaded_data = data
                return context
    """

    __next_command: AbstractCommand = None
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def __call__(self, context: Union[Dict[str, Any], Any]) -> Any:
        """Execute the command with the given context.
        
        Args:
            context: Processing context containing execution data and dependencies.
            
        Returns:
            The result of command execution, typically the modified context.
            
        Raises:
            Exception: If command execution fails.
        """
        if self.__next_command:
            LOGGER.debug(f"Executing next command: {self.__next_command.__class__.__name__}")
            return await self.__next_command(context)
    
    def set_next(self, next_command: AbstractCommand) -> AbstractCommand:
        """Set the next command in the chain.
        
        This method allows chaining commands together.
        
        Args:
            next_command: The next command to execute after this one.
            
        Returns:
            The next command instance.
        """
        self.next_command = next_command
        return next_command

class CommandHandler:
    """Handler for executing a chain of commands sequentially.
    
    This class orchestrates the execution of multiple commands in order,
    passing a mutable context between them.
    
    Example:
        handler = CommandHandler(
            DataLoadCommand(),
            DetailedMetadataCommand(),
            SummarizeCommand()
        )
        result = await handler.execute(initial_context)
    """
    
    def __init__(self, *commands: AbstractCommand):
        """Initialize the command handler with a sequence of commands.
        
        Args:
            *commands: Variable number of command instances to execute in order.
        """
        self.commands = commands
    
    async def execute(self, context: Union[Dict[str, Any], Any]) -> Any:
        """Execute all commands in sequence with the given context.
        
        Args:
            context: Initial context passed to the first command.
            
        Returns:
            The final result after all commands have executed.
            
        Raises:
            Exception: If any command in the chain fails.
        """
        result = context
        
        for command in self.commands:
            try:
                LOGGER.debug(f"Executing command: {command.__class__.__name__}")
                result = await command(result)
            except Exception as e:
                LOGGER.error(f"Command {command.__class__.__name__} failed: {e}")
                raise
        
        return result

class EcommerceDataIndexing:
    """Comprehensive ecommerce data indexing and processing pipeline.

    This class orchestrates the complete ecommerce data indexing workflow including:
    - Basic product loading and indexing
    - Structure recognition and category analysis
    - Attribute extraction and product enrichment
    - Message generation for marketing purposes

    The pipeline supports both basic and professional plans with different levels
    of AI-powered analysis and enrichment capabilities.

    Args:
        ecommerce_repo: Repository for ecommerce data storage and retrieval.
        collection_repo: Repository for collection data management.
        llm_models: Factory for large language model instances.
        embedding_models: OpenAI embedding model for vector generation.
        product_loader: Loader for fetching product data from external sources.

    Example:
        >>> indexing = EcommerceDataIndexing(repo, collection_repo, llm, embeddings, loader)
        >>> result = await indexing.load_and_index_products(
        ...     "store_123", woocommerce_auth, plan="pro"
        ... )
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        ecommerce_repo: IRobotEcommerceRepository,
        collection_repo: IRobotCollectionRepository,
        llm_models: ILLMModelFactory,
        embedding_models: OpenAIEmbeddings,
        product_loader: BaseProductLoader,
        url_validator: IAdvertismentInterface = None,
    ):
        self.ecommerce_repo = ecommerce_repo
        self.collection_repo = collection_repo
        self.llm_models = llm_models
        self.embedding_model = embedding_models
        self.product_loader = product_loader
        self.category_extractor = CategoryExtractor(ecommerce_repo, collection_repo, product_loader)
        self.light_prompts = deepcopy(light_prompts)
        self.heavy_prompts = deepcopy(heavy_prompts)
        self.medium_prompts = deepcopy(heavy_prompts)
        self.chains = self.load_chains()
        self.url_validator = url_validator
        self.basic_subscription_indexing = BasicSubscriptionDataIndexing(
            ecommerce_repo, collection_repo, product_loader, embedding_models
        )
        self.structure_analyzer = StructureAnalyzer(
            ecommerce_repo, self.category_extractor, self.chains, self.url_validator
        )
        self.attribute_extraction = AttributeExtraction(
            ecommerce_repo, self.structure_analyzer, self.chains, product_loader, embedding_model=embedding_models
        )
        self.message_generator = MessageGenerator(ecommerce_repo, self.chains)

    def load_chains(self) -> None:
        chains = {}
        model_map = {
            "heavy": self.llm_models.get("o3-mini"),
            "medium": self.llm_models.get("gpt-4.1-mini"),
            "light": self.llm_models.get("light-model"),
        }

        def build_chain(prompt_object, model):
            return deepcopy(prompt_object.template) | model | llm_result_correction_chain | prompt_object.parser

        for prompt_name, prompt_object in {**self.heavy_prompts, **self.light_prompts, **self.medium_prompts}.items():
            model_type = (
                "medium"
                if prompt_name in self.heavy_prompts
                else "medium"
                if prompt_name in self.medium_prompts
                else "light"
            )
            model = model_map[model_type]
            chains[prompt_name] = build_chain(prompt_object, model)

        return chains

    async def load_and_index_products(
        self,
        ecommerce_identifier: str,
        ecommerce_auth: Union[WoocommerceAuth, MixinAuth, DigifyAuth],
        ecommerce_reference_data: ReferenceData = None,
        max_pages: Optional[int] = 150,
        modified_after: Optional[str] = None,
        plan: Literal["basic", "pro"] = "basic",
    ):
        collection_info = await self.collection_repo.get_collection_info_by_id(ecommerce_identifier)
        if not collection_info:
            raise ValueError(f"Collection with identifier {ecommerce_identifier} not found.")
        if ecommerce_reference_data:
            await self.collection_repo.add_reference_data_to_collection(
                collection_info.identifier, [ecommerce_reference_data]
            )
        # FIXME: Untile we can get the plan from ParsChat Backend
        # FIXIME: woocommerce_auth must not be present in here.
        # FIXIME: the name of the subscription must not be found in here. It must be in the controller.
        allowed_websites = [
            "nooryar.ir",
            # "ilozi.com",
            # "acestyle.ir",
            # "pyaco.ir",
            # "asrtools.com",
            "sooneshan.com",
            "parsichatai.ir",
            "iranshaver.ir",
            # "nasot.ir",
            "banehstorshik.ir",
            # "behroozco.com",
            "bazarbartar.com",
            "ailamarket.com",
            "nilanikan.shop",
            "nillanikan.ir",
            "aghayekhallagh.com",
            "manteofficial.com",
        ]

        parsed_url = urlparse(ecommerce_auth.store_url)
        website_domain = parsed_url.netloc.strip("www.")
        website_host = parsed_url.path.strip("www.")

        is_allowed_website = website_domain in allowed_websites or website_host in allowed_websites

        if plan == "basic" and not is_allowed_website:
            return await self.basic_subscription_indexing.basic_subscription_load_and_index_products(
                ecommerce_identifier,
                ecommerce_auth,
                max_pages=max_pages,
                modified_after=modified_after,
            )

        elif plan == "pro" or is_allowed_website:
            return await self.pro_subscription_load_and_index_products(ecommerce_identifier, ecommerce_auth)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown plan: {plan}")

    async def pro_subscription_load_and_index_products(
        self, ecommerce_identifier: str, ecommerce_auth: Union[WoocommerceAuth, MixinAuth, DigifyAuth]
    ) -> Tuple[List[dict], List[dict], List[Product]]:
        """Load and index products for professional subscription plan.
        This method performs a comprehensive indexing pipeline including:
        - Basic product loading
        - Structure recognition
        - Product attribute extraction
        - Advertisement message generation
        Args:
            ecommerce_identifier: Unique identifier for the ecommerce store.
            woocommerce_auth: WooCommerce authentication credentials.
        Returns:
            Tuple containing:
            - List of categories with their products.
            - List of attributes extracted from products.
            - List of updated products with enriched details.
        """

        LOGGER.info(f"Starting ecommerce data indexing plan pro pipeline for {ecommerce_identifier}...")

        LOGGER.info(f"Stage 1: Basic Product Loading for {ecommerce_identifier}...")
        (
            ecommerce_result,
            descriptions,
        ) = await self.basic_subscription_indexing.basic_subscription_load_and_index_products(
            ecommerce_identifier,
            ecommerce_auth,
        )

        # TODO: retrieve only instock and on_sale products from the beginning. Move getting of instock products to the repository
        ecommerce = await self.ecommerce_repo.get_ecommerce_by_id(ecommerce_identifier)
        ecommerce.products = [
            product for product in ecommerce.products if product.on_sale and product.stock_status == "instock"
        ]

        LOGGER.info(f"Stage 2: Structure Recognition for {ecommerce_identifier}...")
        categories, attributes, category_products, tone_mode = await self.structure_analyzer.structure_recognition(
            ecommerce_identifier, ecommerce
        )

        new_products = [product for product in ecommerce.products if not product.custom_attributes]
        new_products = new_products if len(new_products) < 100 else new_products[:500]  # temporary
        #
        LOGGER.info(f"Stage 3: Product Extra Details (reviews, and sales) for {ecommerce_identifier}...")
        new_products = await self.get_products_extra_details(new_products, ecommerce_auth)
        # new_products = [product for product in new_products if product.reviews]

        LOGGER.info(f"Stage 4: Product Attribute Extraction for {ecommerce_identifier}...")
        updated_products = await self.attribute_extraction.extract_product_attributes(
            ecommerce_identifier, new_products, categories, attributes, category_products
        )

        new_products = []
        for _, products in category_products.items():
            new_products.extend(products[:3])

        LOGGER.info(f"Stage 5: Advertisement Message Generation for {ecommerce_identifier}...")
        updated_products = await self.message_generator.generate_messages(
            ecommerce_identifier, new_products, categories, category_products, tone_mode
        )

        LOGGER.info(f"Shopping assistant indexing pipeline completed for {ecommerce_identifier}.")
        return categories, attributes, updated_products

    async def get_products_extra_details(
        self, products: List[Product], ecommerce_auth: Union[WoocommerceAuth, MixinAuth, DigifyAuth]
    ) -> List[Product]:
        """Retrieve and update extra details for a list of products, including total sales and reviews.

        Args:
            products: List of products to update.
            ecommerce_auth: Ecommerce authentication credentials (WooCommerce or Mixin).

        Returns:
            List of products with updated extra details.
        """
        # Use the factory to get the appropriate loader
        if hasattr(self.product_loader, "get_loader"):
            actual_loader = self.product_loader.get_loader(ecommerce_auth)
        else:
            actual_loader = self.product_loader

        orders_task = actual_loader.get_all_orders(ecommerce_auth)
        reviews_task = actual_loader.fill_product_reviews(ecommerce_auth, products)
        orders, _ = await asyncio.gather(orders_task, reviews_task)

        product_sales: dict[int, int] = {product.id: 0 for product in products}

        for order in orders:
            if not order or not order.line_items:
                continue
            for item in order.line_items:
                if item.product_id in product_sales:
                    product_sales[item.product_id] += item.quantity

        for product in products:
            product.total_sales = product_sales.get(product.id, 0)

        return products
